description: Rejected, a known over-detection kept deliberately (references/1.3.0): `docs` written as a word, where the snapshot has a `docs` directory, is a path, so left undeclared it fails REF-001. The same happens to a script named like a directory, as `test` is in ofetch (ses_dd088742).
section: IMPL §3.3.5 step 7 (REF-001), §3.4 (references/1.3.0: snapshot names in inline code), §3.8
